pages.text: In a landfill, unlike other places, you must always be careful, otherwise you may fall into a pit with acid. I found out about it by accident when I dropped a bucket with my tools into it. Right before my eyes, all my metal tools melted, but the surprisingly fragile bucket remained intact. I think I can use it to process the melted scrap metal.
Attaching a photo of one such lake.
I tried to write down as many recipes as possible so that I would not forget myself and help the reader of this diary, if of course someone finds it and wants to read it.
